exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb-like construction".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
Verb ように (〜you ni)
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ように (〜you ni) matches "Verb-like construction".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ように (〜you ni).
exercises.explanation: Expresses similarity, manner, or purpose: "like," "as if," or "so that."
